<mxfile host="Electron" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) draw.io/28.2.8 Chrome/140.0.7339.240 Electron/38.4.0 Safari/537.36" version="28.2.8" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="iQ50qvZdnuorLA0EDOCo"> <mxGraphModel dx="2056" dy="2324" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": " graph TD
 %% Force straight Orthogonal line rendering
 linkStyle default interpolate linear;

 %% --- LEFT COLUMN ---
 subgraph LeftColumn [\" \"]
 direction TB
 Start([Start]) ---> LitReview[\"Literature Review & Research Gap Analysis\"]
 LitReview ---> GDIProp[\"Understanding GDI Technique & Properties\"]
 GDIProp ---> MathModel[\"Mathematical Modeling & Boolean Derivation<br/>(A>B, A=B, A<B)\"]
 MathModel ---> DesignGDI[\"Design 10T GDI 1-Bit Magnitude Comparator<br/>& Transistor Sizing (W/L)\"]
 end

 %% --- RIGHT COLUMN ---
 subgraph RightColumn [\" \"]
 direction TB
 Benchmark[\"Benchmark Topologies Construction<br/>(Static CMOS 32T, PTL 10T, TGL 16T)\"] ---> SimResult[\"LTSpice Simulation & Parameter Extraction<br/>(180nm PTM, VDD=1.8V | Delay, Power, PDP)\"]
 SimResult ---> Decision{\"Is Output & Performance<br/>Satisfactory?\"}
 
 %% Decision Loops
 Decision -- No ---> Redesign[\"Redesign & Optimize Transistor Aspect Ratios\"]
 Redesign ---> SimResult
 
 Decision -- Yes ---> ThesisWriting[\"Thesis Writing & Performance Evaluation<br/>(Multi-Node Scaling & Complex Engineering P1-P7)\"]
 ThesisWriting ---> End([End])
 end

 %% --- CONNECTION BETWEEN COLUMNS ---
 DesignGDI ---> Benchmark

 %% --- STYLING ---
 style LeftColumn fill:none,stroke:none;
 style RightColumn fill:none,stroke:none;

 style Start fill:#ffe0b2,stroke:#f57c00,stroke-width:2px,rx:0,ry:0;
 style End fill:#ffe0b2,stroke:#f57c00,stroke-width:2px,rx:0,ry:0;
 style SimResult fill:#bbdefb,stroke:#1976d2,stroke-width:2px,rx:0,ry:0;
 style Decision fill:#c8e6c9,stroke:#388e3c,stroke-width:2px,rx:0,ry:0;
 style Redesign fill:#c8e6c9,stroke:#388e3c,stroke-width:2px,rx:0,ry:0;

 style LitReview fill:#ffffff,stroke:#333333,stroke-width:1.5px,rx:0,ry:0;

 style Benchmark fill:#ffffff,stroke:#333333,stroke-width:1.5px,rx:0,ry:0;
 style ThesisWriting fill:#ffffff,stroke:#333333,stroke-width:1.5px,rx:0,ry:0;",
